Contract suite exercises the domain ReservationService module, not the HTTP wire path in src/server.ts; OpenAPI↔HTTP mapping remains implement-aligned rather than HTTP-integration-tested. Soft-hold behaviors remain checkable via OpenAPI + OCL-derived Vitest at standard density (SC6).
